sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Sushi Run is a simple yet engaging game that revolves around the concept of picking sushi pieces before your opponent does, all within a limited number of moves. The game starts with two players facing each other, with a plate of sushi in the middle. The objective is to pick the sushi pieces using your chopsticks, which decreases in number every time you move them. The player with the most sushi pieces at the end of the game wins. Sounds easy, but it's not as simple as it seems, as the game requires a combination of speed and strategy to succeed.

One of the key features of Sushi Run is its use of power-ups and special sushi pieces. These can give you an edge over your opponent by allowing you to pick additional sushi pieces or moving quickly around the plate.
